name: Efficient in Elmsford Winter 2025

venue.name: Cubicle Auxiliary Building
venue.address: 8 Westchester Plaza, Suite 195, Elmsford, New York 10595
venue.details: All the way around the building, look for the Cube New England banner

information: This competition only has blind events and FMC. While first-timers are welcome to attend, we recommend checking out other area competitions if they want to compete in traditional events and have an experience closer to what can be expected from other competitions. Due to the limited space, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest during the competition.
